tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0272", "detail": "PO line 1 'Cat6 Network Cable (box)' is priced at 1,520,100 per unit for 2 units."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "0229/PSG/IX/2026", "detail": "Invoice line 1 bills 2 units at 1,744,900 per unit (3,489,800), above the PO price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-032#2.1", "detail": "Clause 2.1: unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of the Agreement."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-032#2.2", "detail": "Clause 2.2: a price change takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties; no such addendum was found."}], "explanation": "The invoice's unit price of 1,744,900 exceeds the PO price of 1,520,100, and no signed addendum authorising a higher contract price exists, so the excess is an overcharge."}]}
